deskNote: Crude / energy risk is today's first filter because crude remains the key transmission line for import costs, aviation fuel, OMC margins and inflation expectations. Track Brent against 23,412.6; sentiment at -0.09 says the first range must prove direction. Sector breadth decides whether a Nifty move becomes a trend; Bank Nifty VWAP hold is the minimum bar. Let the first 15 minutes print, then trade only the side that holds VWAP with breadth behind it.

news.headline: Manappuram Finance, IIFL Finance, other stocks rally up to 11% as gold prices soar after import duty hike
news.summary: Shares of gold financiers Manappuram Finance, Muthoot Finance and IIFL Finance rallied sharply after the government raised import duty on gold to 15%, triggering a surge in domestic gold prices. Higher gold prices improve collateral value for gold loans, potentially boosting lending demand and benefiting companies focused on gold-backed financing businesses.
news.takeaway: Shares of gold financiers Manappuram Finance, Muthoot Finance and IIFL Finance rallied sharply after the government raised import; India import duty change on gold or silver directly shifts domestic landed cost and MCX price discovery.
news.whyItMatters: A tariff on gold or silver imports changes MCX spot vs. international gold spread, landed cost for jewellers, and sovereign gold bond premiums — all before the equity open.
news.indiaImpact: MCX Gold, MCX Silver, listed jewellers (Titan, Kalyan, Senco), SGBs and gold ETFs need re-pricing; import cost change is immediate and measurable.
news.watchFor: Watch MCX Gold open vs. international spot gap, USD/INR for transmission magnitude, and jeweller breadth (Titan, Kalyan, Senco) by 9:45 AM IST.
